name: Tintek & Rakdong River Trails
description: Secluded sub-tropical village paths descending toward the Teesta River, offering uncrowded natural riverbanks, hanging footbridges, and bamboo groves.

name: Hee Bermiok & Chhubing Cave Cascades

name: Sanga Choeling Monastery Rear Ridge

name: Dzongu Lepcha Primitive Reserve (Passingdang & Tingvong)
description: A strictly protected, indigenous Lepcha ancestral homeland featuring terraced river valleys, hanging cane bridges, and untouched subtropical cloud forests.

name: Lingthem Village & Gompa

name: Singhik Viewpoint Old Bridle Paths

name: Malam Waterfall & Rongyung Chu Shallows

name: Tarey Bhir (Sadhu Khol Gorge)

name: Kitam Bird Sanctuary Buffer Paths

name: Maniram & Phalidanda Cardamom Slopes
description: A peaceful agricultural hamlet known for large-cardamom plantations, traditional drying kilns (bhattis), and panoramic views of the southern hills.

name: Tendong Hill Ancient Hermitage Trail
description: A steep walking route cutting through thick oak and magnolia forests leading to a sacred Lepcha hilltop lookout tower.

name: Aritar Lampokhari Lake Rear Foot-Trails
description: The quiet, cobblestone and dirt walking loops winding through dense rhododendron and fir woods above the emerald, boot-shaped natural lake.

name: Mankhim Hilltop & Kirat Rai Temple
description: An elevated vantage point above Dalapchand offering sweeping views of the eastern Himalayas, old prayer flags, and ancestral tribal heritage grounds.

name: Rolep River Valley & Shokey Khola Cascades
description: A pristine, secluded valley along the Rangpo River basin featuring crystal-clear mountain pools, traditional trout-rearing ponds, and bamboo homestays.

name: Mulkharka Lake (Sikkim–Bengal Border Ridge)
description: A high-altitude sacred lake hidden inside dense mossy forests, famous for reflecting Mount Kangchenjunga on its mirror-still surface on calm mornings.

name: Chakung & Pine Hill Viewpoint
description: A tranquil ridge settlement surrounded by pine plantations, offering misty sunrise panoramas over the Rangeet river valley below.

name: Rinchenpong Poison Pokhari & Heritage Bungalow
description: A quiet, historic pond linked to ancient indigenous guerrilla warfare against invading forces, framed by British-era forest trails and old stone chortens.
